# Sunrun Announces Date for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Report


October 07, 2026 8:00 AM EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f562621f86ba07389b6f0f0a72247a4e/sunrun/news/2026-10-07_Sunrun_Announces_Date_for_Third_Quarter_2026_383.pdf)


### Earnings Release and Conference Call Scheduled for November 4, 2026


SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sunrun (Nasdaq: RUN) today announced that it will issue its third quarter 2026 earnings report after the market closes on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. A conference call has been scheduled to discuss these earnings results at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time / 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time.


The conference call can be accessed live via the Sunrun Investor Relations website at[https://investors.sunrun.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=JY2R_yX3LY4ouZ6YwcTrEAPfsk4s9TTpxohmHQM-rzRcU5cW9rhTX8z9yinfzCB9kuMG39RWt5i9imbUrJH40uwMNhnixh-ONLoELsxI3xinxQn_d2UUGp_ob7KBU-ML) . An audio replay will be available following the call on the Sunrun Investor Relations website for approximately one month and a transcript of the conference call will be posted to the Sunrun Investor Relations website the following day.


**Event:** **Sunrun 3Q 2026 Earnings Call**


**Date:** Wednesday, November 4, 2026


**Call Time:** 4:30PM ET / 1:30PM PT


**Dial-in (toll-free/toll):** (877) 407-5989 / (201) 689-8434


**Webcast / Replay:**[https://investors.sunrun.com](https://investors.sunrun.com/)


**About Sunrun**
Sunrun Inc. (Nasdaq: RUN) is America’s largest provider of home battery storage, solar, and home-to-grid power plants. As the pioneer of home energy systems offered through a no-upfront-cost subscription model, Sunrun empowers customers nationwide with greater energy control, security, and independence. Sunrun supports the grid by providing on-demand dispatchable power that helps prevent blackouts and lower energy costs. Learn more at www.sunrun.com.
